notes.title: Nemorsys (New gameplay trailer) + major updates
notes.content: [p][b]Major Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Smoother Field of View:[/b] Improved visual transitions and camera movement for a more immersive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skills Overhaul:[/b] Revamped skill system featuring 25 unique and rebalanced skills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Overhaul:[/b] A redesigned user interface for better clarity, accessibility, and aesthetics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Village Atmosphere Enhancements:[/b] Chickens and birds added to bring more life and realism to the environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Event:[/b] Solving a clue may now trigger a surprise zombie attack, adding tension and unpredictability to gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b][/p]
